score 0.24terms related to "Business", "Customer", "University", formal structures ("AACSB", "consolidation"), specific entities ("auditorium", "telephone number")

This neuron's dominant (large-magnitude, negative) response occurs on the token immediately preceding a capitalized "B"-initial word/abbreviation (Bremerton, B., BPA, Bugs), i.e. it is a next-token "B..." predictor position; its much weaker positive activations are scattered on mid-phrase nouns/word-continuations in compound phrases (e.g. "drive" in "3.5" drive trays", "-through", "able" in "Favorable").
